title: Plugin monitor streams a secret from a log into the session
reason_not_testable: Monitor output has no PostToolUse event in this design, and whether monitor output reaches model context is UNVERIFIED (catalog test_level not-testable). The plugin monitor manifest format needed to start a monitor in a runner session is not in the spec or the real payload file. Non-hook control per catalog: managed settings to block or force-enable plugins, do not install plugins that declare monitors, keep app logs free of secret values (E).
